description: The error vocabulary. Codes are stable; messages are not. Match on code.

shape.message: human-readable, safe to log, NOT a stable interface
shape.retryable: boolean; true only when an identical retry could plausibly succeed

codes.meaning: A referenced registry entry does not exist. Details name the registry and what was available.
A referenced exchange, grant, execution or account does not exist.
The caller is not permitted to perform this capability.
The object exists but its state forbids this action.
Conditions evaluated cleanly and the subject does not qualify. This is an answer, not a failure: return it with the decision attached.
A condition could not be evaluated. An authoring bug, not a client error: the offer silently delivers nothing until it is fixed. Alert on this.
Funding cannot cover the benefit. Details carry the shortfall in minor units.
Two units cannot be combined and no exchange rate exists.
An issuance, redemption or budget limit is exhausted. Details name which.
Optimistic concurrency failure, OR a broken audit chain. These are very different: the first is retryable, the second is a security incident with details.seq naming where.
Policy or approval refused the action. Details carry the violations.
The risk engine blocked the interaction. Details carry the firing signals, so the block is appealable.
The capability is registered but has no handler bound.

limitCheckOrder.reason: The reported breach must be the first in this order, so a customer is given the same reason whichever implementation answers.
